name: Freeform — the named escape hatch
description: One permissive stage for operational and investigative spawns; forcing createWorktree:false keeps code-writing work from silently routing around the gated playbooks.

freeform.description: For a one-off with nothing to plan or review — answer a question, read a log, run a command. Brief the goal and its sentinel. The worker is in the live project tree, so the moment the job turns into code changes, stop and re-run it under a playbook that reviews and lands.
